Who We Are

A Legacy of Academic Excellence

ISA
Immaculate Stars Academy

Proudly serving families in Abuja with quality education at Nursery, Primary, and Secondary levels — building tomorrow's leaders with integrity, knowledge, and vision.

A+School Rating

Immaculate Stars Academy stands as a beacon of quality education in Abuja. From our Nursery through Secondary school, we have been committed to providing a nurturing, stimulating environment where every child's unique potential is recognized and cultivated.

Our motto — "Laying a Solid Foundation" — is not just a phrase. It is the guiding principle behind every class taught, every value instilled, and every future we help shape.

🏅 Academic Excellence

Rigorous curriculum aligned to national standards with outstanding exam outcomes.

❤️ Character Formation

We develop responsible citizens with strong moral values and integrity.

🌱 Holistic Development

Sports, arts, culture and co-curricular activities complement academics.

👨‍👩‍👧 Family Partnership

Strong communication with parents through our online portal and meetings.

Join Our Family

How to Apply

Enrolling at ISA is straightforward. Follow the steps below and complete the enquiry form — our admissions team will contact you within 24 hours.

1

Submit an Enquiry

Fill in the enquiry form with your child's details and desired entry level. Our team will reach out to schedule a meeting.

2

School Visit & Assessment

Attend a guided tour and entrance assessment appropriate to your child's age and level.

3

Offer Letter & Acceptance

Receive an admission offer. Review, sign, and confirm acceptance with the required documents.

4

Fee Payment & Enrolment

Complete fee payment and receive your child's student ID, uniform details, and resumption date.

Admission Enquiry
